scope: Primary ruling analogy for custom King activation versus post-cost selection; not a direct custom-card FAQ or live Omega certification. No production change.

primary_source.title: How can Daigusto Emeral activate its effect?

finding: Emeral needs at least one performable mode before activation. Paying detachment cost can then enable another mode or supply selectable GY cards; it cannot bootstrap activation when neither mode was initially performable. Applied by analogy, King needs an already eligible Hand/GY summon resource, but after legally activating it may summon its newly detached material.
candidate_disposition: Reject prospective overlay-group activation OR: it admits empty-resource activation and incorrectly treats a summon-prohibited overlay material as available. Original King source passes corrected native activation/selection tests.
related_limit: Do not infer blanket invalidity or validity of earlier Origins destruction/then-banish checks; distinct sequential effect requires its own rule/evidence scope.
